cases.input: An agent keeps processing a job while the owner sleeps
cases.plan: All propositions become the same sparse dashboard rectangle. Tiny status icons fade in. Bot points without touching anything. Blank field, no environmental story reason.

cases.input: An agent handles a chain of errands
cases.plan: Original postage-sorting miniature: a curved parcel chute receives a held work spool; Bot grips and routes it; parcels visibly emerge in destinations. Pinboard, canvas mailbag and wall cubbies form one subordinate postal world. Reset when authorization enters. Distinct from selected source heroes, sets and choreography.

Deliberately replicate selected reference hero objects, miniature environment and choreography together; same source character climbing the identical six software menu rows and same camera poses, replacing only labels.

cases.input: Sensitive actions require the owner to approve
cases.plan: A static APPROVE label fades over generic UI. No held key, barrier, submission, denied motion, or visible consequence; Bot passively points. Reference calibration expects a tangible interface with contact and a causally withheld action.

cases.input: Would you give it the keys?
cases.plan: Intentional dramatic minimalism: a very large held key approaches a closed lock and stops with a legible gap; owner keeps possession. Subtle hinge recoil settles. A quiet final question contrasts the earlier busy montage. Caption-free retained ownership is visible; large texture-bearing paper shapes and contact shadows remain.
